description: Installing the hooks into ~/.claude/settings.json. The file is read as JSONSerialization reads it (no file, or one blank after trimming whitespacesAndNewlines, is {}; anything that is not a JSON object is refused); a hooks value that is not an object (null too) and, in the order Stop, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, SessionEnd, PostToolUse, an event that is not an array are refused; in each event, entries whose command is the legacy unquoted path are removed (a group left empty is dropped), and when no group holds the quoted command, {"hooks":[{"type":"command","command":<quoted>}]} is appended. Nothing changed means nothing is written. A write is JSONSerialization with .prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys and .withoutEscapingSlashes plus a newline: its collation orders the keys, and numbers are written as it writes them. Every other key and value is copied through; of two equal keys the first is kept.
function: HookInstaller.install(port:token:settingsURL:) — input {settings, scriptPath}: settings the file's bytes (a string, {"hex": <bytes>}, or null for no file), scriptPath the hook script's path; expected {"outcome": "write", "file": <file lines>}, {"outcome": "unchanged"} or {"outcome": "refused", "refusal": "invalidJSON" | "hooksNotAnObject" | "eventNotAnArray", "event": <name, for eventNotAnArray>}
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.6, v2.14; Tests/PowerUpTests/HookFixtureTests.swift testHookInstallTable runs HookInstaller.install on a temporary settings file (settingsURL:, the support directory pointed at the script path's folder) and compares the written bytes exactly. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/hooks.rs install_cases runs hooks::install_edit and compares its JSON with the file as JSON (numbers by value, each string read back as Foundation reads it).
capturedAgainst: Swift 5.9.2 Foundation (Xcode 15.2) on macOS 27.2, PowerUp at 2dd77aa

cases.name: no settings file
cases.reason: A missing file starts from {} and gains our group under each of the five events (HK-180, HK-192).

cases.name: an empty file
cases.reason: A blank file starts from {} (HK-192).

cases.name: a file of whitespace only
cases.reason: The blank test trims whitespacesAndNewlines, which includes U+00A0, U+2028 and U+200B.

cases.name: an empty object
cases.reason: Every event is added; nothing else is written.

cases.name: an empty hooks object
cases.reason: An empty hooks object gains the five events.

cases.name: foreign keys and numbers are kept as written
cases.reason: Unknown keys are copied through (HK-191); JSONSerialization writes them sorted by its collation and numbers as it writes them: 1.0 as 1, 0.1 with 17 digits, -0 as 0 but -0.0 as -0, big integers exactly (HK-417).

cases.name: a foreign Stop group with a matcher
cases.reason: Foreign groups and events stay as they are; ours is appended after them, with no matcher key (HK-183, HK-191).

cases.name: already installed

input.settings: {"hooks": {"Stop": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "UserPromptSubmit": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "Notification": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "SessionEnd": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "PostToolUse": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}]}}

cases.reason: Nothing changes, so nothing is written and no backup is taken (HK-190).

cases.name: already installed among other settings

input.settings: {"model": "opus", "hooks": {"Stop": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "UserPromptSubmit": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "Notification": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "SessionEnd": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "PostToolUse": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}]}}

cases.reason: An install that changes nothing writes nothing, whatever else the file holds (HK-190).

cases.name: a legacy unquoted registration is upgraded
cases.reason: The unquoted path never ran (the shell splits it); install removes it and registers the quoted command (HK-182).

cases.name: legacy and quoted together

input.settings: {"hooks": {"Stop": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh"}]}, {"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "UserPromptSubmit": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "Notification": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "SessionEnd": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "PostToolUse": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}]}}

cases.reason: The legacy entry is removed even when the quoted one is there, and that counts as a change.

cases.name: a legacy entry sharing a group with a foreign one
cases.reason: Only the legacy entry goes; the group keeps the foreign entry and its matcher.

cases.name: one event missing is added

input.settings: {"hooks": {"Stop": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "UserPromptSubmit": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "Notification": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}], "PostToolUse": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "'/tmp/PowerUp Hook Fixture/support/powerup-hook.sh'"}]}]}}

cases.reason: An install from an older build gains only the missing event (HK-188).

cases.name: not JSON
cases.reason: A file that is not JSON is refused and left untouched (HK-192).

cases.name: a JSON array
cases.reason: The root must be an object.

cases.name: a JSON string
cases.reason: A fragment is not a settings file.

cases.name: a number Foundation cannot read
cases.reason: A number past Double's range makes the file invalid JSON for Foundation.

cases.name: a byte order mark is skipped
cases.reason: One UTF-8 byte order mark is read past; the rewrite has none.

cases.name: a UTF-16 file is refused
cases.reason: Recorded difference (HK-417): Foundation read a UTF-16 or UTF-32 settings.json, the core refuses it as invalid JSON and leaves it untouched. Claude Code reads its settings as UTF-8, so such a file was never one it could use. Synthetic: the Swift app before the core installed into it.

cases.name: invalid UTF-8
cases.reason: Bytes that are not UTF-8 make the file invalid.

cases.name: a stray A9 byte in a string reads as a replacement character
cases.reason: Foundation reads a lone 0xA9 inside a string as U+FFFD (HK-393), and that is what the rewrite holds.

cases.name: hooks that is an array
cases.reason: A hooks value of the wrong shape is refused rather than overwritten (HK-192).

cases.name: hooks that is null
cases.reason: null is present and not an object, so it is refused too.

cases.name: hooks that is a string
cases.reason: A hooks value of the wrong shape is refused.

cases.name: Stop that is an object
cases.reason: An event of the wrong shape is refused (HK-192).

cases.name: a later event of the wrong shape
cases.reason: Events are checked in the order Stop, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, SessionEnd, PostToolUse, and the first wrong one is named.

cases.name: Stop that is null
cases.reason: null is not an array.

cases.name: an empty Stop array
cases.reason: An empty array gains our group.

cases.name: odd groups are kept
cases.reason: A group that is not an object, or has no hooks array, or entries that are not ours, is kept as it is; ours is appended.

cases.name: duplicate hooks keys
cases.reason: Of two equal keys Foundation keeps the first, and the rewrite holds it alone.

cases.name: duplicate foreign keys
cases.reason: The first of two equal keys wins and the second is not written back.

cases.name: a deep foreign value
cases.reason: A value 512 containers deep (the root included), the most Foundation reads, is copied through as it is.

cases.name: escaped and raw text
cases.reason: Strings are written as JSONSerialization writes them: slashes raw, controls escaped, everything else as UTF-8.

cases.name: a leading U+FEFF in strings
cases.reason: Foundation drops one U+FEFF at the start of a string or key, raw or escaped; a second one is kept.

cases.name: a trailing comma
cases.reason: Foundation accepts one trailing comma.

cases.name: whitespace around the object
cases.reason: Space, tab, LF and CR may surround the root.

cases.name: a command that is not ours
cases.reason: A command is ours only when it equals the quoted or legacy path exactly (HK-183).

cases.name: the quoted path with a single quote
cases.reason: The command registered for a path with a quote is the escaped one.
